```{r functions, include = F}
aggregate_data <- function(data, 
                           cols_to_keep, 
                           pop_col,
                           agg_noneuca = TRUE){
  
  pop_cols <- c("pop_ACS", "pop_MPI")
  
  data_pop <- data %>% 
    select(-setdiff(pop_cols, pop_col)) %>%
    rename("pop" = !!sym(pop_col))
  
  raw_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
  # find geographic keys
  geo_keys <- intersect(cols_to_keep, c("state", "region"))
  
  # aggregate regions if requested
  if(agg_noneuca){
    data_pop <- data_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "Non-EUCA")) %>%
      group_by(pick(-c(n_arrests, pop))) %>%
      summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
                pop = sum(pop))
    
    raw_pop <- raw_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "Non-EUCA")) %>%
      group_by(state, region) %>%
      summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  }
  # population map
  pop_map <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
   # checksum value
  checksum <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n=1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarize(pop_checksum = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")

  # aggregate arrests, join population back in
  data_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by_at(cols_to_keep) %>%
    summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pop_map, by = geo_keys) %>%
    mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000,
           log_pop = log(pop))
  
  # checksum
  total_aggregated <- data_pop %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(pop) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  total_checksum <- sum(checksum$pop_checksum, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!(dplyr::near(total_checksum, total_aggregated))) {
    warning("Checksum Failed!")
  }
  
  return(data_pop)
}

jackknife_supt <- function(fe_fit, model_fml, data, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), extra_fml = NULL, do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = F, m_vals = c()) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  coef0      <- coef(fe_fit)
  states     <- unique(data$state)
  n_states   <- length(states)

  windows <- setdiff(min(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))):max(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))), -1)

  if (do_se) {
    jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
      sub_data <- subset(data, state != dropped_state)

      if (model_type == "poisson") {
        coef(fepois(model_fml, data = sub_data, offset = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      } else {
        coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      }
    }))

    # calculate variance-covariance matrix
    jackknife_est_means <- colMeans(jackknife_est_matrix)
    vcov_unscaled       <- jackknife_est_matrix |>
      scale(center = jackknife_est_means, scale = FALSE) |>
      crossprod()
    scaling_factor <- (n_states - 1) / n_states
    vcov           <- scaling_factor * vcov_unscaled
    se             <- sqrt(diag(vcov))

    # Gaussian sup-t critical value
    # (Montiel Olea & Plagborg-Møller 2019)
    sims           <- rmvnorm(10000, sigma = cov2cor(vcov))
    critical_value <- quantile(apply(abs(sims), 1, max), 0.95)

    if (model_type == "poisson") {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = exp(coef0), se = se,
                     lower  = exp(coef0 - critical_value * se),
                     upper  = exp(coef0 + critical_value * se))
    } else {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = coef0, 
                     se = se,
                     lower  = coef0 - critical_value * se,
                     upper  = coef0 + critical_value * se)
    }
  } else {
    est_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") exp(coef0) else coef0
    supt    <- tibble(window = windows, est = est_val, se = 0, lower = est_val, upper = est_val)
  }

  ref_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") 1 else 0
  output <- supt |>
    bind_rows(tibble(window = -1, est = ref_val, se = 0, lower = ref_val, upper = ref_val)) |>
    arrange(window)
  
   if(do_sensitivity){
    honest_data <- output |> filter(window != -1) |> arrange(window)
    honest_betahat <- honest_data$est
    honest_sigma <- vcov
    
    numPrePeriods <- 6
    numPostPeriods <- 9
    pre_period_indices <- 1:numPrePeriods
    l_vec <- rep(1 / numPostPeriods, numPostPeriods)
    
    # wald
    pre_coef_names <- names(coef0)[1:numPrePeriods]
    wald_test <- fixest::wald(fe_fit, keep = pre_coef_names, vcov = vcov)
    
    print("Wald Pre-Trend Test p-value: ")
    print(wald_test$p)
    
    delta_rm_results <- HonestDiD::createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
                                    betahat = honest_betahat,
                                    sigma = honest_sigma,
                                    numPrePeriods = numPrePeriods,
                                    numPostPeriods = numPostPeriods,
                                    l_vec = l_vec,
                                    method = "C-LF",
                                    Mbarvec = m_vals
                                    )

    print("M bar Results")
    print(delta_rm_results)
    
  } 
  return(output)
  
}

plot_predictions <- function(data, pal, baseline, type = c("linear", "poisson")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  
  data <- data %>% mutate(plot_y = ratio)
  y_lab <- "Arrests per 1k"
  
  # Group and color by the specific interaction of region and conviction status
  # to prevent the line from zig-zagging between EUCA and nonEUCA at the same window
  plt <- ggplot(data, aes(x = window, y = plot_y, color = color_group, shape = color_group, group = color_group))
  
  if (type == "poisson") {
    plt <- plt + scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "grey50")
  } else {
    plt <- plt + geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, color = "grey50")
  }
  
  plt <- plt +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) + 
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    labs(x = "Time Period", y = y_lab) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(data$window), max(data$window), by = 1)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())+
    scale_color_manual(values = pal)+
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_palette)
    
  return(plt)
}

event_study_plot <- function(estimates, pal, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), baseline = 0) {
  if (!"conv_status" %in% colnames(estimates)) {
    estimates <- estimates |> 
      dplyr::mutate(conv_status = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))
  }
  #interaction_colors <- c(
  #  "EUCA No Conviction"    = "#555555",
  #  "EUCA Conviction"       = "#BBBBBB",
  #  "Non-EUCA No Conviction" = "#004488",
  #  "Non-EUCA Conviction"    = "#6699CC"
  #)
  #"Non-EUCA Conviction", "Non-EUCA No Conviction"
  conv_methods <- unique(estimates$conv_method)
  estimates <- estimates %>%
  mutate(
    window_dodged = case_when(
      conv_method == conv_methods[1] ~ window - 0.15,
      conv_method == conv_methods[2] ~ window + 0.15,
      TRUE ~ window 
    )
  )
  
  df_bottom <- estimates %>% filter(conv_method == conv_methods[1])
  df_top    <- estimates %>% filter(conv_method == conv_methods[2])

  
  plt <- ggplot(estimates, aes(x = window, y = est, group = conv_method, color = conv_method, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    #geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
    #geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
    #geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(0.3), aes(shape = conv_method)) +
    geom_line(data = df_bottom, aes(x = window_dodged, y = est, group = conv_method), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(data = df_bottom, aes(x = window_dodged, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
    geom_point(data = df_bottom, aes(x = window_dodged, y = est, shape = conv_method), size = 2.5) +
    geom_line(data = df_top, aes(x = window_dodged, y = est, group = conv_method), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(data = df_top, aes(x = window_dodged, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
    geom_point(data = df_top, aes(x = window_dodged, y = est, shape = conv_method), size = 2.5) +
    labs(x = "Time Period", 
         y = "Difference in Arrests per 1k\nrelative to EUCA") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(estimates$window), max(estimates$window), by = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_palette)

  return(plt)
}

fit_diffindiff <- function(data, model_fml, extra_fml, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = FALSE, m_vals = c()) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  int_fml    <- formula(paste(as.character(model_fml)[2], "~ i(window, region, ref2 = 'EUCA') | window"))
  
  method_coefs <- lapply(unique(data$conv_method), function(cur_method) {
    d_filt  <- data %>% filter(conv_method == cur_method)
    is_pois <- model_type == "poisson"
    
    mod     <- if(is_pois) fepois(model_fml, d_filt, offset = extra_fml, cluster = ~state) else feols(model_fml, d_filt, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state)
    mod_int <- if(is_pois) fepois(int_fml, d_filt, offset = extra_fml, cluster = ~state) else feols(int_fml, d_filt, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state)

    int_val <- coef(mod_int)[grepl("window::-1:", names(coef(mod_int)))]
    if(length(int_val) == 0) int_val <- 0 # Fallback in case of missing baseline

    jackknife_supt(mod, model_fml, d_filt, model_type, extra_fml, do_se, do_sensitivity, m_vals = m_vals) %>%
      mutate(conv_method = cur_method, period_minus_1_val = int_val)
  })
  
  res <- bind_rows(method_coefs)
  return(res)
}

arrange_figure2 <- function(conv_method, conv_method_state, model_fml, wt_fml, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, title = "", do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = FALSE, m_vals = c()) {
  interaction_colors <- c(
    "EUCA No Conviction"    = "#555555",
    "EUCA Conviction"       = "#BBBBBB",
    "Non-EUCA No Conviction" = "#004488",
    "Non-EUCA Conviction"    = "#6699CC"
  )
  
  did_colors <- c(
    "CA No Conviction"  = "#004488", 
    "CA Conviction"     = "#6699CC",
    "LEA No Conviction" = "#004488", 
    "LEA Conviction"    = "#6699CC",
    "No Conviction"     = "#004488",
    "Conviction"        = "#6699CC"
  )

  conv_method <- conv_method %>% 
    mutate(
      conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"),
      color_group = paste0(region, " ", conv_status) 
    )
    
  message("Fitting linear models...")
  lin_estimates <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state, model_fml, wt_fml, "linear", do_se, do_sensitivity, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))
    
  message("Fitting poisson models...")
  pois_estimates <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, "poisson", do_se, FALSE, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))

  pA <- plot_predictions(conv_method, interaction_colors, 0, "linear") + 
    ylab("Arrests per 1k") +
        theme(legend.direction = "horizontal")+
     labs(tag = "a") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14))+
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

  pB <- event_study_plot(lin_estimates, did_colors, model_type = "linear", baseline = 0) + 
  ylab("Non-EUCA - EUCA Arrests per 1k\nrelative to period -1") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "b") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14,  margin = margin(r = 10)))

  pC <- plot_predictions(conv_method %>% mutate(ratio = n_arrests), interaction_colors, 0, "poisson") +
    ylab("Total Arrests\n(Log Scale)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "c") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14))
      
  pD <- event_study_plot(pois_estimates, did_colors, model_type = "poisson", baseline = 1) + 
    ylab("Non-EUCA / EUCA Arrests\nrelative to period -1") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ labs(tag = "d") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)))
  
  left_column <- (pA / pC) + 
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect")
  right_column <- (pB / pD) + 
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect")
  
  combined_plot <- (left_column | right_column) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
    title = title, 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ))
    
  return(combined_plot)
}


arrange_figure2_v2 <- function(conv_method_ca, conv_method_state_ca, 
                               conv_method_lea, conv_method_state_lea, 
                               model_fml, wt_fml, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, title = "", do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = FALSE, m_vals = c()) {
  interaction_colors <- c(
    "EUCA No Conviction"    = "#555555",
    "EUCA Conviction"       = "#BBBBBB",
    "Non-EUCA No Conviction" = "#004488",
    "Non-EUCA Conviction"    = "#6699CC"
  )
  
  did_colors <- c(
    "CA No Conviction"  = "#004488", 
    "CA Conviction"     = "#6699CC",
    "LEA No Conviction" = "#004488", 
    "LEA Conviction"    = "#6699CC",
    "No Conviction"     = "#004488",
    "Conviction"        = "#6699CC"
  )

  conv_method_ca <- conv_method_ca %>% 
    mutate(
      conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"),
      color_group = paste0(region, " ", conv_status) 
    )
  conv_method_lea <- conv_method_lea %>% 
    mutate(
      conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"),
      color_group = paste0(region, " ", conv_status) 
    )
  message("Fitting linear models...")
  lin_estimates_ca <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state_ca, model_fml, wt_fml, "linear", do_se, do_sensitivity, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))
  lin_estimates_lea <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state_lea, model_fml, wt_fml, "linear", do_se, do_sensitivity, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))
    
  message("Fitting poisson models...")
  pois_estimates_ca <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state_ca, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, "poisson", do_se, FALSE, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))
  pois_estimates_lea <- fit_diffindiff(conv_method_state_lea, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, "poisson", do_se, FALSE, m_vals) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "No Conviction"), "No Conviction", "Conviction"))

  pA <- plot_predictions(conv_method_ca, interaction_colors, 0, "linear") + 
    ylab("Communtiy Arrests\nper 1k") +
        theme(legend.direction = "horizontal")+
     labs(tag = "a") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))+
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

  pB <- event_study_plot(lin_estimates_ca, did_colors, model_type = "linear", baseline = 0) + 
  ylab("Non-EUCA - EUCA Community\nArrests per 1k relative to period -1") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "b") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14,  margin = margin(r = 10)),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))

  pC <- plot_predictions(conv_method_ca %>% mutate(ratio = n_arrests), interaction_colors, 0, "poisson") +
    ylab("Total Community Arrests\n(Log Scale)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "c") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))
      
  pD <- event_study_plot(pois_estimates_ca, did_colors, model_type = "poisson", baseline = 1) + 
    ylab("Non-EUCA / EUCA Community\nArrests relative to period -1") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ labs(tag = "d") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))
  
  pE <- plot_predictions(conv_method_lea, interaction_colors, 0, "linear") + 
    ylab("LEA Arrests per 1k") +
        theme(legend.direction = "horizontal")+
     labs(tag = "e") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))+
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

  pF <- event_study_plot(lin_estimates_lea, did_colors, model_type = "linear", baseline = 0) + 
  ylab("Non-EUCA - EUCA LEA\nArrestsper 1k relative to period -1") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "f") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14,  margin = margin(r = 10)),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))

  pG <- plot_predictions(conv_method_lea %>% mutate(ratio = n_arrests), interaction_colors, 0, "poisson") +
    ylab("Total LEA Arrests\n(Log Scale)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    labs(tag = "g") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))
      
  pH <- event_study_plot(pois_estimates_lea, did_colors, model_type = "poisson", baseline = 1) + 
    ylab("Non-EUCA / EUCA LEA\nArrests relative to period -1") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ labs(tag = "h") + 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8))
  
  
  left_column <- (pA / pC / pE / pG) + 
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect")
  right_column <- (pB / pD / pF / pH) + 
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect")
  
  combined_plot <- (left_column | right_column) + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
    title = title, 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ))
    
  return(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r, include = F}
  paste0("ratio ~ i(window, region, ref = -1, ref2 = 'EUCA') | region + window")
)

  paste0("n_arrests ~ i(window, region, ref = -1, ref2 = 'EUCA') | region + window")
)
offset_fml <- as.formula("~log_pop")

    "CA No Conviction"  = 15, 
    "CA Conviction"     = 17,
    "LEA No Conviction" = 15, 
    "LEA Conviction"    = 17,
    "No Conviction"     = 15, 
    "Conviction"        = 17,
    "EUCA No Conviction" = 15,
    "EUCA Conviction"  = 17,
    "Non-EUCA No Conviction" = 15,
    "Non-EUCA Conviction"  = 17
  )
```

```{r}
make_figure_suite <- function(data, save_folder = "supplement", save_prefix = "", do_sensitivity = F, m_vals = c()){
  conv_method_ca <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "window"), 
                                        "pop_MPI", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "CA"))

  conv_method_state_ca <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                        "pop_MPI", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "CA"))

  conv_method_lea <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "window"), 
                                        "pop_MPI", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "LEA"))

  conv_method_state_lea <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                        "pop_MPI", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "LEA"))

  # figure 2 MPI denoms (CA)
  arrange_figure2_v2(conv_method_ca, conv_method_state_ca, 
                  conv_method_lea, conv_method_state_lea,
                model_fml, wt_fml, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, 
                "", do_sensitivity = do_sensitivity, m_vals = m_vals)
  ggsave(paste0("../figures/", save_folder, "/", save_prefix, "mpi_denoms_fig2.pdf"), height = 10, width = 6.5) 
  
  # figure 2 ACS denoms
  conv_method_ca <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "window"), 
                                        "pop_ACS", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "CA"))

  conv_method_state_ca <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                        "pop_ACS", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "CA"))
  
  conv_method_lea <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "window"), 
                                        "pop_ACS", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "LEA"))

  conv_method_state_lea <- aggregate_data(data, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                        "pop_ACS", 
                                        TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>% 
    filter(startsWith(conv_method, "LEA"))

  arrange_figure2_v2(conv_method_ca, conv_method_state_ca, 
                     conv_method_lea, conv_method_state_lea,
                model_fml, wt_fml, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, 
                "", do_sensitivity = F)
  ggsave(paste0("../figures/supplement/", save_prefix, "acs_denoms_fig2.pdf"), height = 10, width = 6.5)
}
```

Test for significance
```{r, sig_test, echo = F}
trajectory <- read_csv("../data/processed/glm_trajectory_type_threatlevel_convicted_ACS_MPI.csv")

# create four groups
trajectory <- trajectory %>%
  mutate(conv_method = ifelse(method == "LEA", 
                              ifelse(convicted == 1, "LEA Conviction", "LEA No Conviction"),
                              ifelse(method == "CA", 
                                     ifelse(convicted == 1, "CA Conviction", "CA No Conviction"),
                                     NA)))

conv_method_state <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                      "pop_MPI", 
                                      TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>%
  filter(window >= -1) %>%
  mutate(window = ifelse(window < 0, -1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(region, window, pop, state, conv_method) %>%
  summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests)) %>%
  mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000)
  
return_p_value <- function(data){
  mod <- feols(model_fml, data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state)
  states <- unique(data$state)
  n_states <- length(states)
  
  mean_val <- unname(coef(feols(model_fml, data = data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state)))
  
  jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
    sub_data <- subset(data, state != dropped_state)
    coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state))
  }))
  var = sum((jackknife_est_matrix - mean_val)^2)*(n_states-1)/(n_states )
  se = sqrt(var)
  z = mean_val/se
  print(pnorm(-abs(z))*2)
  
  c(mean_val, mean_val - 1.96*se, mean_val + 1.96*se)
}

print("LEA Conviction:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "LEA Conviction"))

print("LEA No Conviction:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "LEA No Conviction"))

print("CA Conviction:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "CA Conviction"))

print("CA No Conviction:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "CA No Conviction"))
```
